subject: Annotation_logticks on outside of y axis?

messages.subject: Annotation_logticks on outside of y axis?
parts:
I am looking for an easy way to implement log ticks on the OUTSIDE of panels, graphs etc on the left of y axis. Through some searching, this does not look possible without exorbitant amounts of ggplot hacks, which I don’t really understand how to implement. Am I missing something - is there an easier way to do this?  Below are some links to the hacks I think might accomplish it, but I’m not sure. Are there plans to add such a functionality to the standard ggplot under annotation_logticks in future (such as using negative units under the short, mid, and long parameters)?

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/39767900/log-ticks-on-the-outer-side-of-axes-annotation-logticks

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/39767900/log-ticks-on-the-outer-side-of-axes-annotation-logticks
